def test_cycpattern_check():
    # basic rotation cases
    assert cycpattern_check("abcd", "abd") is False
    assert cycpattern_check("abab", "baa") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("efef", "eeff") is False
    assert cycpattern_check("himenss", "simen") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("himenss", "simens") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("himenss", "simenss") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("himenss", "simensss") is False

    # b longer than a -> impossible
    assert cycpattern_check("ab", "aba") is False

    # b is empty -> matches trivially
    assert cycpattern_check("abc", "") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("", "") is True

    # a empty, b not -> no match
    assert cycpattern_check("", "a") is False

    # exact substring (no rotation needed)
    assert cycpattern_check("hello", "ell") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("hello", "olle") is True

    # full rotation of entire a
    assert cycpattern_check("waterbottle", "erbottlewat") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("waterbottle", "botlewatter") is False

    # repeated characters / rotations
    assert cycpattern_check("aaaa", "aa") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("abcabc", "cab") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("abcabc", "acb") is False

    # single characters
    assert cycpattern_check("a", "a") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("a", "b") is False
